## Question

State one precise mathematical question and assign or reference a claim ID.

## Why it matters for Collatz

Explain the exact implication chain to the original conjecture. Distinguish a
direct implication from a useful partial result.

## Known related claims

Link rows in `docs/CLAIMS_LEDGER.md`, failures in
`docs/FAILED_APPROACHES.md`, and any primary literature.

## Proposed route

List assumptions, intermediate lemmas, and the intended exact arithmetic.

## Fast falsification test

Give the smallest counterexample search and include the mandatory adversarial
families where relevant.

## Success criterion

State what evidence changes the claim status and what would cause the work to
stop.

## What this result would not prove

Describe the interpretation boundary in advance.
